reasoning: Law property art. 1 forbids knowingly taking or interfering with another agent's property without permission. The highest-weight evidence shows plot 17 is owned by Maple and Nova entered it (ev_c7c6920ca69c4ebabc67b98b881891f0), then harvested 5 timber from that plot (ev_fb8e57aa0032462298d088944fe271fd). A prior world-verified note from Maple to Nova saying 'Please don't take anything from my plot while I'm away' supports lack of permission and Nova's knowledge (ev_5b10d14598024898989b2fa7c6bb003e). There is no contrary evidence in the record. On this record, the charged property violation is proved.

sentence.description: Return 5 timber taken from Maple's plot 17 to Maple.
Do not enter Maple's plot 17 to take or interfere with Maple's property without permission.
